SELECT ic.id, ic.name, ic.contact_name as contactName, ic.contact_phone as contactPhone, ic.address, ic.status, ic.create_time as createTime, ic.update_time as updateTime, COUNT(ie.id) as employeeCount FROM insured_company ic LEFT JOIN insurance_employee ie ON ic.id = ie.company_id AND ie.is_deleted = 0 AND ie.status = 1 WHERE ic.is_deleted = 0
AND ic.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.name}, '%')
AND ic.status = #{query.status}
GROUP BY ic.id, ic.name, ic.contact_name, ic.contact_phone, ic.address, ic.status, ic.create_time, ic.update_time ORDER BY ic.create_time DESC
